w:r.w:t: An e-commerce platform to sell apparel a different way. Using recommendations in a totally different way, revolutionizing the way you shop. Using feed totally personalized to your liking, dynamically tuned based on your changing moods. You demand and we change tune it to your needs.

is a next-generation mobile e-commerce platform for apparel in the Indian market, designed for fashion-forward millennials and Gen Z. It revolutionizes the online shopping experience by merging a fun, intuitive, AI-driven discovery engine (inspired by dating apps) with a traditional, feature-rich e-commerce interface.
Our core value proposition is to eliminate "choice paralysis" and make discovering new fashion styles an engaging and personalized journey, not a chore.

The current Indian e-commerce landscape for apparel is saturated and overwhelming. Users are faced with endless scrolling through thousands of products, most of which are irrelevant to their personal style. This leads to:
Users get tired and abandon their search.
Recommendations are often generic and based on simple browsing history, not a deep understanding of the user's taste.
Finding new brands or styles that genuinely fit a user's aesthetic is difficult and time-consuming.
StyleSwipe solves these problems by offering a dual experience:

A "Tinder-style" interface where users are presented with one product at a time. They can swipe right ("Like") or left ("Dislike"). Each swipe feeds our recommendation engine, which learns their preferences in real-time and shows them more relevant items.
A traditional, grid-based interface where users can browse by categories (T-Shirts, Jeans, Kurtas, Dresses, etc.), filter, and search for specific items.
This hybrid model caters to two distinct shopping moods: the user who wants to explore and be inspired, and the user who knows exactly what they are looking for.

6. Initial User Profiling Questions (The Recommendation Engine Kickstart)

This onboarding quiz is presented immediately after a user signs up. The goal is to capture their core style DNA in under 60 seconds. We will use a highly visual, card-based interface for these questions.
The most fundamental filter for the entire app experience.
"Which of these styles best represents you?"
A grid of 4 clickable images, each showing a distinct style aesthetic. Users can select one or two.
To quickly categorize a user's high-level style preference. The tags associated with the chosen image (minimalist, streetwear) become the highest-weighted attributes for their profile.
"How do you like your clothes to fit?"
[ Slim Fit ] [ Regular Fit ] [ Relaxed / Oversized ]
Fit is a critical preference. This helps filter out styles a user would never wear, regardless of how they look.
"Which color palette are you usually drawn to?"
A grid of 4 clickable color palette swatches.
Narrows down recommendations significantly and is a strong indicator of personal taste.
"What's the main reason you're shopping today?"
[ Everyday Casual ] [ Work & Office Wear ] [ Party & Occasions ] [ Loungewear ] [ Vacation Style ]
Helps understand the user's immediate needs and lifestyle, allowing for more relevant initial recommendations.
Shopping experience that is no more boring and limited to item tiles.
